text: Broker Roy Lopez sends 100 percent of his referrals to Bennett Medical Centre — all 8 of them — while holding a 22.9 percent stake; transfers exceed expected commission by 8.3 percent on a small 11,674 dollar book. Every absolute number here is tiny, and the clinic is accredited, so this reads as a small declared-stake facilitation arm; the score reflects that. The 100 percent referral share is a function of the broker's size, not the clinic's dependence (0.3 percent of its claims). Next step: none standalone; revisit if this broker's volume grows.
